name: walk_brisk
text: A person steadily walks straight forward with comfortable moderate steps and an upright torso. Arms stay relaxed and swing gently just beside the hips. Maintain a regular purposeful walking rhythm at about 1.7 metres per second, without jogging, exaggerated strides, or high arm swings.

trim.reason: Middle complete cycle of three sparse phase-constrained cycles. Pilot2 frames 79-109 supplied phases; no joint editing or time scaling.

review.reason: 重生试片后取79至109帧完整步态作稀疏相位约束；生成91帧只约束13帧（14.29%，最小间隔7帧），取中间30至60帧。平均水平速度1.837m/s，步幅比普通walk略大，手臂低位自然摆动；首尾同姿势，未修改关节或调速。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
